summary: Discover how to align AI initiatives with your business goals through our expert training. Enhance your strategy and drive success today!
lede: Aligning AI initiatives with business goals connects AI opportunities and delivery choices to business outcomes, governance, and measurable value. For professionals in strategy, delivery, governance, or analytics, the course builds practical skills in framing business problems, assessing use-case value and data readiness, designing KPIs and risk controls, and translating priorities into an AI roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with strategy, delivery, governance, or analytics and need a practical way to align AI initiatives with business goals. The audience includes both business and technology roles that influence AI selection, approval, measurement, and reporting. AI Product Managers who define and prioritize AI use cases. Digital Transformation Leads who coordinate AI adoption across functions. Business Analysts who translate business problems into AI requirements. Strategy Managers who connect AI initiatives to corporate objectives. Data Governance Specialists who assess data readiness and controls. Innovation Managers who filter and shape AI opportunity pipelines. Enterprise Architects who align AI use cases with operating models. PMO Leads who track AI milestones, dependencies, and reporting. Risk Managers who review AI governance, bias, and escalation paths. Functional Heads who sponsor AI initiatives and monitor business impact.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and a current or proposed AI initiative from your own work context. A basic understanding of KPIs, business cases, and cross-functional project work will help you complete the exercises effectively.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
